import http from 'node:http';import {handle} from './handlers.mjs';
export const createApp = () => http.createServer(async(req,res)=>{try{let raw='';for await(const c of req)raw+=c;res.setHeader('content-type','application/json');res.end(JSON.stringify(handle(JSON.parse(raw))));}catch{res.statusCode=400;res.end('{}');}});

import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {createApp} from './server.mjs';
test('HTTP shipping contract',async()=>{const server=createApp();await new Promise(r=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',r));try{const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+server.address().port,{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({units:2,price:7,delivery:3})});assert.equal(r.status,200);assert.deepEqual(await r.json(),{value:17});}finally{server.closeAllConnections();await new Promise(r=>server.close(r));}});
